people.description: Optional people relevant to the news.

emotion.description: Desired emotional tone. Choose a suggestion or enter a custom value.

format_type.description: One presentation format for the entire reel. Choose a suggestion or enter a custom value.

theme.description: Dramatic premise and angle for the script.

core_message.description: Minimum accurate news fact or core message conveyed.

idea.description: Optional upstream reel idea or premise to incorporate into the dialogue.

ideas.description: Optional array of upstream reel ideas from which premises can be drawn.

theme.description: Optional top-level dramatic premise and angle for the script.

core_message.description: Optional top-level minimum news message to convey.

output_count.description: Number of distinct script variations to return.

scene_duration_seconds.description: Target duration for each scene, in seconds.

scene_count.description: Target number of scenes for each script variation.

min.description: Minimum words per second for spoken dialogue.

max.description: Maximum words per second for spoken dialogue.

wps_range.description: Allowed speaking pace in words per second for timing dialogue. Defaults to 2.5–3.5 WPS.
